description: Defines data structures, constants, and inline functions for ext2 filesystem implementation in Zephyr OS, including superblock, inode, directory entry, block group, and filesystem context structures.

methods.name: inode_current_block
methods.description: Inline function to get the current block of an inode based on its block level.

methods.name: inode_current_block_mem
methods.description: Inline function to get the memory pointer of the current block of an inode.
